sources_considered.why: Primary account of a randomized learning study. It tests a related concern but not workplace screening or released-code quality.
Read the paper. Its seniority and prior-productivity comparisons do not establish incompetence, concealment or defects in deployed software.
The security experiment does not establish that otherwise excluded engineers gained workplace access and shipped the tested code.
read_page returned HTTP 403; the accessible author manuscript was inspected instead.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, summary of randomized study results
evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic reported weaker immediate mastery among participants learning a new library with AI assistance. The date identifies that research announcement; the page does not separately date the experiment, which did not measure workplace screening or shipped defects.

unresolved_gaps: No inspected study establishes the full chain from baseline incompetence through workplace acceptance to worse production code.
Short-term learning performance does not establish pre-existing incompetence.
The claim's counterfactual—that these engineers would otherwise be excluded—remains unmeasured.
